reasons.plausibility: It leverages a well-established principle (powder bed preheating) that is scientifically sound for reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing microstructures in additive manufacturing.
reasons.testability: A direct comparison of preheated vs. non-preheated builds can be conducted with measurable outcomes (residual stress, defects, homogeneity, mechanical properties).
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses the known challenges in high-entropy alloy additive manufacturing and proposes a practical, targeted process change that could improve performance.
